dedupe_keys.name: inland wetland spatial data and wetland status map of korea national institute of ecology

description: The Korean National Institute of Ecology publishes on the public data portal the spatial data and attributes of 2,704 inland wetlands in Korea. For each wetland the shapefile gives its location coordinates, boundary polygon, name and code, centroid, administrative area, whether it is a Ramsar wetland and its national wetland type; the institute describes uses in ecosystem conservation policy, wetland management, environmental impact assessment and spatial ecological information. The file uses the Korea 2000 Central Belt 2010 coordinate system (EPSG 5186) in UTF-8, was registered in July 2022 and was modified on 25 September 2026, with irregular updates. The institute's wetland status map page shows protected wetland areas and Ramsar sites, such as the Nakdong River estuary (37.7 square kilometres, a Ramsar site since August 1999), with their location, area and features, and links the EcoBank ecological spatial information service. Use is free and the licence places no restriction on use. Caveats: the data covers inland wetlands, not coastal tidal flats, and updates are irregular. Coverage is the Republic of Korea. It supports environmental screening and nature-based flood retention analysis for roads, dams and other infrastructure near wetlands; related records are the Czech watercourses and wetlands portal and the Ducks Unlimited boreal wetland classification.
